## Wallet changes

refactoring only, check this declaration:

## Wallet submissions

If this pull request adds or updates a wallet, fill out the wallet submission
template in the PR description before requesting review:

https://github.com/kaspamedia/kaspa-org/blob/main/.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE/wallet-submission.md

Wallet PRs with blank descriptions or missing wallet submission details will not
pass review.
